description: Preserve canonical bare CASE behavior when later museum cases are also in scope.

replacements.new:
<CONSTANT SHAVE 2>

<ROUTINE PREFER-TROPHY-CASE (TBL TLEN LEN "AUX" POS LAST OBJ)
	 <SET POS <+ .TLEN 1>>
	 <SET LAST <+ .TLEN .LEN>>
	 <REPEAT ()
		 <SET OBJ <GET .TBL .POS>>
		 <COND (<EQUAL? .OBJ ,TROPHY-CASE>
			<PUT .TBL <+ .TLEN 1> ,TROPHY-CASE>
			<PUT .TBL ,P-MATCHLEN <+ .TLEN 1>>
			<RTRUE>)>
		 <COND (<EQUAL? .POS .LAST> <RFALSE>)>
		 <SET POS <+ .POS 1>>>>

<ROUTINE GET-OBJECT
